guide.subtitle: Our 2026 Guide
guide.heading: Honest rankings for Irish punters
guide.body:
Choosing an online bookmaker in Ireland has never been simple. The market is packed with brands making big promises, inflated bonus claims and terms that hide the real conditions deep in the small print. That's the problem {{site_name}} was built to solve.

We're an independent editorial team of experienced gambling analysts and former industry insiders. We spend our time filtering out the noise so you only see platforms that are properly licensed, thoroughly tested and proven to pay out without hassle. Whether you're after value on Premier League prices, a flutter on the GAA or an each-way bet at Leopardstown, our ratings are built on real testing and are never paid for.

how_we_rate.subtitle: How We Rate
how_we_rate.heading: How we score Irish betting sites
how_we_rate.intro: Every operator goes through a detailed, multi-step review before it can appear in our rankings. Our specialists — with more than 40 years' combined experience — open real accounts, deposit real money, test withdrawals and question customer support. Commercial relationships never change a score — see our [affiliate disclosure](affiliate-disclosure.html) for how we're funded.

criteria.title: Licensing & compliance
criteria.text: Nothing matters more than a valid licence. We confirm each operator is authorised by a recognised regulator — the Gambling Regulatory Authority of Ireland (GRAI), the Malta Gaming Authority or the UK Gambling Commission — and that it runs proper age checks and anti-money-laundering controls. No verifiable licence, no listing.

criteria.title: Welcome offer & fair terms
criteria.text: A big headline figure is meaningless if the small print is stacked against you. We read every welcome offer in full — minimum odds, qualifying stakes, free-bet expiry and any rollover — and reward bookmakers whose terms are short, clear and genuinely achievable.

criteria.title: Markets & odds
criteria.text: We compare depth and pricing across the sports Irish punters actually bet on: Premier League and European football, GAA hurling and football, UK and Irish racing, rugby, golf and more. In-play coverage, bet builders, cash out and live streaming all count towards the score.

criteria.title: Payments & withdrawals
criteria.text: Slow cash-outs are the number-one complaint we hear. We deposit and withdraw ourselves, logging accepted methods, fees and the real time it takes for money to land. Operators that pay out within 24 hours score best; deliberate delays are marked down hard.

criteria.title: Mobile experience
criteria.text: Most Irish players bet from their phones, so we test iOS and Android apps as well as the mobile site — load times, navigation, bet-slip speed and whether every key feature works on a small screen. A clunky mobile product costs points, however good the desktop site is.

criteria.title: Responsible gambling tools
criteria.text: Good operators help you stay in control. We check that deposit limits, reality checks, time-outs and self-exclusion are easy to find and easy to use, and that support services such as GamblingCare.ie are signposted clearly — not hidden several menus deep.
